summary: Raise the Go toolchain floor to 1.26.10 and golang.org/x/net to v0.62.0 so two reachable vulnerabilities are fixed when the CLI is built.
reason: Publish-time govulncheck on go 1.26.9 and x/net v0.55.0 reported GO-2026-6809 (crypto/x509, fixed in go1.26.10) and GO-2026-6860 (x/net, fixed in v0.62.0). The README and SKILL install sections move to 1.26.10 too, which is also the text verify-skill now expects from the generator.
validated_outcome: `cli-printing-press publish validate` passes govulncheck and verify-skill; `go build ./...` and `go test ./...` pass on go1.26.10.
